properties.description:
Built 2026-10-13 on branch feat/the-changelog-shows-a-balance, to the accepted dec:how-the-changelog-balance-is-counted (option C). In progress until the PR merges and a release carries it.

AT THE CUT, WITH NO NEW TOOL: release_includes_all with apply: true also keeps the release's STATUS SNAPSHOT (crates/reflow2-core/src/balance.rs). It is a Snapshot node `snap:release-status:<release>` whose `target_id` is the release (so HAS_SNAPSHOT links them) and whose `state` holds the payload: the status of every Requirement, Capability, Decision and Verification, each marked `discontinued` when an accepted decision has withdrawn it, since a stored status does not move on withdrawal. The first is stored whole; each later one as a delta (`set` of new or changed entries, `removed` ids) from the release with the highest epoch sequence below it that keeps one. A release not yet pinned to an epoch, which is the normal case at step 4 of flow:release-cut, is taken as the newest. The payload names its base, and reading back follows the chain. The manifest edges and the snapshot are written in one batch. The reply's `status_snapshot` says written / already_kept / dry_run / not_taken, how it is stored, its base, and how many entries it holds. A re-run never rewrites a snapshot. A release whose manifest was frozen before the call, or with a later release already keeping one, gets none, because today's statuses are not what it saw.

IN changelog_view: the draft gains `balance` (from and to ends with their source; `counted`): requirements added against dropped or deferred, capabilities added against removed or withdrawn, decisions accepted against reversed, checks gone from passing to failing, and the window's pinned test_failure_fix ChangeEvents as failures that came back. Each column carries `how_counted` and its items, each with before, after and how. An end with no snapshot is named in `balance.notes` and its counts are absent, never zero. `limits` states the net-count blind spot (added and taken away inside one window is in neither column), that it never says which change moved something, that [Unreleased] reads the last deployed release against the live design, and that it never says a design does too much. Additive only: both tools' replies gained one field each and nothing else moved shape.

Every Decision is counted, gap acknowledgements (decision:ack:*) included, and the decisions column is symmetric: accepted at one end and not at the other, so a reopen (accepted to proposed) or deferral also reads as reversed, with `how` naming the move.

NAMED FOLLOW-UP, NOT BUILT: back-filling past releases from the design copy committed at each tag, which the decision includes. Until it is built, every release cut before this keeps no snapshot and the balance names it. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.name: changelog_view's draft carries a balance line: requirements, capabilities and decisions added beside those taken away or reversed, and failures that came back, each count saying how it was counted
